interface.defaultPrompt: Use MTerm-CLI to verify my workstation tools. For configuration, connection recovery or the current plugin package, open https://m-techlabs.com/admin/mcp and its Plugin & recovery section. Never request or reveal service tokens.
interface.longDescription: MTerm-CLI is a private workstation connection through M-TechLabs owner OAuth. Manage the existing service at https://m-techlabs.com/admin/mcp: shared request concurrency 1–64, read-only and pause controls, engineering capability gates, jobs and recovery. The Plugin & recovery section provides a versioned downloadable archive, checksums and account-specific reconnect guidance. Plugin settings cannot override ChatGPT platform OAuth or create a native Reconnect button: OAuth consent must be completed in ChatGPT, and sometimes removing/readding the app is necessary. Do not uninstall local MTerm-CLI, its manager, or Cloudflare Tunnel to repair a ChatGPT-side session. Privileged tool operations require explicit capabilities and policy gates. ChatGPT sessions, independent CLI tools, and hosted Desktop Commander remain separate.

name: m-techlabs-desktop
description: MTerm-CLI private owner-managed workstation connector with remote tool controls, connection recovery, and secure release downloads.
